main.description: A user favorite for an AT Store app listing. Subject is the at:// URI of a fyi.atstore.listing.detail record. Games are favorited with games.atmosphere.fave instead, so the favorite is shared with atmosphere.games; AT Store counts both.

subject.description: AT URI of the fyi.atstore.listing.detail record being favorited (a games.atmosphere.define URI is also accepted for older game favorites).
